articles.summary: Mach9 announces native LGSx integration with Leica Geosystems, enabling field-to-finish mapping workflows from Leica Pegasus TRK, RTC360, BLK360, and BLK2GO into Digital Surveyor 2 for automated feature extraction.
articles.title: Mach9 Customers Unlock New Productivity Gains with Seamless Leica LGSx Integration

articles.summary: Mach9 announces a $12 million seed funding round led by Quiet Capital to scale Digital Surveyor, its AI-powered geospatial mapping software for large-scale infrastructure projects.
articles.title: Mach9 Raises $12 Million Led by Quiet Capital to Scale AI-Powered Geospatial Mapping Solutions
